title: Prompt-Decision Credit on Retention Payoffs
content:
Prompt-decision credit — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

**Rule.** On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the prompt-decision credit is deducted in the retention balance figure. It is figured from the latest accepted intent declaration on the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, when that declaration states that the borrower will retain the property and its request date is on or before the case's response deadline: it is USD 500.00 when the case carries no granted extension entry, and USD 500.00 less USD 125.00 for each granted extension entry on the case, not below 0.00, when it carries one or more. A case whose latest accepted intent declaration states another intent or is dated after the response deadline, or that has none, has no credit (0.00).

**Declarations on the same day.** Where several accepted intent declarations on the case share the latest request date, the latest declaration states an intent to retain the property only when every one of them does.

| Timely declaration to retain the property | Granted extensions on the case | Prompt-decision credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | USD 500.00 |
| yes | 1 | USD 375.00 |
| yes | 2 | USD 250.00 |
| yes | 3 | USD 125.00 |
| yes | 4 or more | 0.00 |
| no (another intent, dated after the deadline, or none) | any | 0.00 |

A declaration dated on the response deadline itself is timely; one dated the day after is not.
